en.title: M
en.summary: The letter M is the thirteenth letter of the Romanian alphabet.

sections.title: The letter em
paragraphs: The letter name is (mare) /ˈma.mə/, which means mother. Its main sound is heard in that same word. This letter makes two distinct sounds in Romanian speech.

sections.title: Mouth movements
paragraphs: Close both lips together. Send air out through your nose while your voice hums. For the softened sound, press the middle of your tongue upward at the same time. You can feel your throat buzz with your fingers.

sections.title: Spelling rules
paragraphs: In most places, you pronounce the sound /m/, that is standard m. An example is (om) /om/. At the end of a word before short i, you say the sound /mʲ/, that is softened m. You hear this in the word (dormi) /dormʲ/.

sections.title: Common mistakes
paragraphs: This sound matches the English sound in moon. The softened sound is like the start of mute, but without a full vowel. Keep the lips fully shut until the sound ends.
